cards.lore: "The Riders made straight for you, as soon as you fled.'"

cards.title: White Faces Burned
cards.gameText: Make a skirmishing twilight Nazgul strength +1 for each wound on the Ring- bearer (and damage +1 if that Nazgul is The Witch-king).
cards.lore: "Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear."

cards.title: Fell to Its Power
cards.gameText: Discard a [Sauron] Orc to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may discard a Free Peoples condition to prevent this.
cards.lore: "'If the Dark Lord knows so much as you say, Mithrandir, will he not rather smile than fear, and with his little finger crush us like a fly that tries to sting him?'"

cards.title: Gaze of the Eye
cards.gameText: Response: If your [Sauron] condition is about to be discarded, remove a burden to prevent this.
cards.lore: "Then the Eye began to rove, searching this way and that; and Frodo knew with certainty and horror that among the many things that it sought he himself was one."

cards.title: I See You
cards.gameText: The site number of each [Sauron] minion is -1 for each burden you can spot.Each [sauron] minion with site number of 1 or less is strength +1. When the Ring-bearer takes off The One Ring, discard this condition.
cards.lore: "...to pin you under its deadly gaze, naked, immovable."

cards.title: It Betrayed Isildur
cards.gameText: Spot 5 burdens and discard a [Sauron] Orc to choose one: make the move limit for this turn -1; or make the Free Peoples player choose to move again (if the move limit allows).
cards.lore: "'He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam, and then the Orcs saw him and killed him with arrows.'"

cards.lore: "'He has indeed arisen again... and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'"
